description:
LANDED fbd2ff6f2 (2026-09-01; refuter FIX-THEN-MERGE, doc-only fixes
folded; gate lib 1533/0, cli 24/0, matrix 425/0/9).

Twice-measured defect: DependencyIndex::unresolved iterated the waiters
HashMap, so the stall diagnostic's wait list was RandomState-ordered --
one release binary, 4 distinct stderr renderings in 5 runs of
00050_empty.fz; 3 md5s in 3 runs of 00421; 90 of 577 fixtures stall, so
corpus stderr was useless as a sweep comparand.

FIX: one packaging sort at the chokepoint -- key (fact Debug rendering,
readiness variant tie-break). Both poking consumers' local sorts folded
away, PROVEN order-identical by in-process differential assertion
(legacy computation vs new, full lib suite + full release matrix, zero
fires). Debug over an Ord bound is deliberate and documented: it is
byte-for-byte the folded callers' key (what makes the fold provable),
and derived Ord over arrow-bearing FactKeys is equally mint-order
tainted (fz-k22.21 class) -- legal here only because the scope is
WITHIN-RUN; the structural poke-path ordering is fz-kdt.114, and the
same defect on the demand_on_stall telemetry stream is fz-kdt.115.
Refuter also proved Debug injectivity over live FactKeys (structural:
derived Debug to primitive fields on all 30 variants; empirical:
adjacent-equal assertion over lib+matrix, zero fires; worst case if
ever broken = duplicated poke, never a merged/dropped fact -- dedup is
PartialEq).

Pins: unit pin builds the same 24-wait set through the PRODUCTION
complete path in two opposite orders (captured RED at base, fully
scrambled); CLI pin runs 3 processes and requires byte-identical stderr
(captured RED with the sort disabled). Post-fix: 5-run md5 stable on
00050/00421 + 3 more stalling fixtures. All 90 corpus stalls are ONE
degenerate 4-wait shape (root entry never defined) -- 00421 is that
same shape (no entry fn), NOT truncation; the unit pin carries the
coverage variety. Bycatch triaged: 00424's run-varying thread id is
std's panic header, not a render site -- no defect.
title: A stalled compile's standing waits are a list, not a map: one packaging sort at the unresolved() chokepoint
